ImageDescription.value: The Xbox 360, a video game console released by Microsoft in 2005.  This is the "Pro" model from the launch line-up, which featured a 20GB hard drive, wireless controller and a silver DVD bezel.  The production date of this unit is 2005-11-05, making it a very early unit.  Of note is the gray on the hard drive at the top, which is very shiny and silvery.  This was changed to a matte gray in later models.
